findings.claim: is_shipped_bound_pilot detects `quorum_semantic: shipped-bound` in contract metadata, causing xpile quorum to count `shipped_binding:` occurrences for pilot contracts and `lean_theorem:` for all other contracts, disclosing the rule in text and JSON output.

Pilot contracts C-PY-INT-ARITH and C-BASHRS-POSIX-IDEMPOTENCE opt in with quorum_semantic: shipped-bound; C-PY-INT-ARITH binds 3 obligations (floor div, mod, shr) to lean_shipped_pilot_witness.rs and C-BASHRS-POSIX-IDEMPOTENCE binds 1 obligation (composition_idempotence_diamond) to bashrs_idempotence_seam_witness.rs.

quorum_semantic_pilot_witness.rs implements 7 comprehensive tests: deriving bound sets from Lean pin blocks both ways, refusing bindings on reimplementation theorems or tests that omit pin blocks, verifying binary tally and disclosure, demonstrating RED arm when pilot marker is stripped (42 -> 3), and enforcing doc sync against live markdown tables and quotes.
Reference documentation in book/src/reference/cli.md documents the pilot rule and incorporates the binary-checked table showing Semantic counts before and after the pilot.

structured_output.summary: The diff fully satisfies ticket PMAT-2163. It restricts Semantic quorum votes to obligations carrying a `shipped_binding:` for pilot contracts opting in via `quorum_semantic: shipped-bound` in `metadata:`. On the two pilot contracts, Semantic votes adjust from 42 to 3 (`C-PY-INT-ARITH`) and from 18 to 1 (`C-BASHRS-POSIX-IDEMPOTENCE`), leaving contract statuses at QUORUM and overall totals at 26 QUORUM / 9 PARTIAL across all 35 contracts. The witness suite `quorum_semantic_pilot_witness.rs` derives the bound set from Lean pin blocks in both directions, tests negative/rejection cases, and verifies doc synchronization. No gates were weakened, and no unrequested changes were introduced.
